outline: 1388 Mental Shortcuts for Adding and Subtracting Integers

examples.question_text:
Evaluate each expression. Say which calculation comes first.
(a) $11\times(9-5)+8$
(b) $84\div(4+3)+6$
examples.solution_text:
(a) First calculate $9-5$ inside the brackets.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}11\times(9-5)+8\\&=11\times4+8\\&=44+8\\&=52\end{aligned}$
(b) First calculate $4+3$ inside the brackets.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}84\div(4+3)+6\\&=84\div7+6\\&=12+6\\&=18\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
Insert one pair of brackets to make each sentence true.
(a) $4+9\times6=78$
(b) $37-13\div8=3$
(c) $96\div5+7\times4=32$
examples.solution_text:
(a) Group the sum before multiplying.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(4+9)\times6\\&=13\times6\\&=78\end{aligned}$
(b) Group the difference before dividing.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(37-13)\div8\\&=24\div8\\&=3\end{aligned}$
(c) Group the sum used as the divisor.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}96\div(5+7)\times4\\&=96\div12\times4\\&=8\times4\\&=32\end{aligned}$
After the brackets, division and multiplication have equal priority, so work from left to right.

examples.question_text:
There are $7$ packs, each containing $13$ red cards and $6$ blue cards.
(a) Write a number sentence using brackets for the total number of cards.
(b) Calculate the total.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Each pack has $13+6$ cards, so the number sentence is $7\times(13+6)$.
(b)
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}7\times(13+6)\\&=7\times19\\&=133\end{aligned}$
There are $133$ cards. The brackets include both colours in every pack.

examples.question_text:
Insert one pair of brackets to make each sentence true.
(a) $8\times11-4+3=59$
(b) $108\div12-3+5=17$
(c) $72-7+5\times6=0$
examples.solution_text:
(a) Group the difference before multiplying.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}8\times(11-4)+3\\&=8\times7+3\\&=56+3\\&=59\end{aligned}$
(b) Group the difference used as the divisor.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}108\div(12-3)+5\\&=108\div9+5\\&=12+5\\&=17\end{aligned}$
(c) Group the sum to make the amount subtracted equal to $72$.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}72-(7+5)\times6\\&=72-12\times6\\&=72-72\\&=0\end{aligned}$
